title: GTA 6 Has More Reveals Planned for November Ahead of Nov 19 Launch
description: Rockstar still has radio stations, merch, PS5 Pro details and possibly another trailer to show before GTA 6 launches on November 19, NoobFeed reports.

body.text: GTA 6 has entered its launch month, and Rockstar Games is not done announcing things. According to NoobFeed, the game is due on November 19, with preload expected to begin on November 12. The outlet says several reveals are still to come, covering music, merchandise, PS5 Pro enhancements and possibly more footage. For anyone choosing a platform or planning for release night, these details matter.
More music is on the way

NoobFeed says Rockstar has already confirmed that it will announce more radio stations and more songs from the official GTA 6 album before launch. Not every station has been revealed yet, and more singles from different artists are expected alongside the station details.

The original score is another gap. Rockstar has teased a dynamic scoring system, but NoobFeed notes that it has not explained how the system works. The outlet expects a fuller breakdown in the coming weeks, though that is its expectation and not a confirmed schedule.

When Rockstar last announced merchandise, an official Newswire post told players to watch for more drops soon, according to NoobFeed. Nothing substantial has followed, which the outlet reads as a sign another collection could land before launch. It suggests that could include more T-shirts, hats and keychains, but that is a guess.
NoobFeed also reports that some promotional locations in Miami have exclusive merchandise that may not appear in the regular online collection.

GTA 6's store page already labels the game as PS5 Pro enhanced, but NoobFeed says neither Rockstar nor Sony has explained what the improvements actually are. Sony's marketing has hinted that the game will run better on the more powerful console.

The outlet calls this one of the most important missing announcements. It could arrive as soon as next week, or it could be held back until closer to preload or release. For players weighing a standard PS5, a PS5 Pro or an Xbox, performance comparisons could decide the purchase.
Another trailer, and a Miami Heat event

NoobFeed notes that Rockstar has already released what appears to be the launch trailer, about a month before release. That makes it unclear whether another traditional trailer is coming. The outlet floats the possibility of a narrated trailer or one focused on the story and on Jason and Lucia, but none of that is confirmed.

Rockstar also appears to be working with the Miami Heat on an NBA promotional event called Night in Vice City, per NoobFeed. Recent sightings around Miami reportedly show modified, GTA 6-inspired cars and a filmed speedboat chase, with police boats pursuing the boat and helicopters overhead. How that footage will be used has not been confirmed.
NoobFeed also mentions reports of a possible Nike shoe collaboration with Rockstar. Treat that as a rumour until Rockstar says something.

Keep an eye on Rockstar's Newswire for radio station lists, new singles and any merch drop. The PS5 Pro details are the big one for platform decisions, and Night in Vice City could bring fresh footage. Preload is expected on November 12, so the next two weeks should show how much Rockstar still plans to reveal before launch day.

sources.title: GTA 6 Has More Major Reveals Planned for November as Rockstar Prepares for Launch With PS5 Pro Details and New Promotions
